author: Edward A. Gait
title: A History of Assam
type: Colonial historical synthesis using translated chronicles and other records
access: Downloaded complete PDF; relevant sections read in extracted text; selected page images prepared.
consulted: Introduction pp. i–vii; pp. 34–46; pp. 67–102; appendix chronology consulted in OCR but table requires visual rechecking.
limitations: Gait did not independently read Tai-Ahom. Translation work involved Barua and Deodhai scholars. Colonial racial explanations rejected. Appendix table OCR is unreliable; narrative pages used for chronology.

author: Golap Chandra Barua, editor and translator
title: Ahom-Buranji, with parallel English translation
type: Edited Tai-Ahom chronicle with English translation
access: Downloaded complete image-only PDF. Selected English-column pages read visually. No usable native text extraction.
consulted: Title and contents; unnumbered preface, PDF page 3; printed pp. 24–25, 34–38, 44–50 (PDF pages 30–31, 40–44, 50–56).
limitations: Only the English translation has been read. Modern headings and paragraphs were editor-added. This chronicle was used by Gait: agreement is not independent corroboration. Regnal passages contain internal date/duration conflicts.

limitations: Modern agricultural thesis, not an eyewitness source or specialist edition of early chronicles. Used narrowly for its statement of uncertainty; wider community characterisations are not adopted.
